document.title: Marquee Selection Callouts
document.purpose: Record temporary screen-space title callouts shown after marquee selection.

summary: After marquee selection commits one or more selected nodes, Data Garden shows a temporary callout overlay listing selected node titles. Each title is rendered as a zoom-independent screen-space canvas text item with a leader line back to the selected node center. Empty marquee selections clear any existing callouts and show none.

overlay-state.ownership: Transient editor/presentation state, not World Model state.

policy: Committed non-empty marquee selection shows callouts.
Committed empty marquee selection clears callouts.
Callouts are not shown during marquee drag preview.

rendering: Callouts are tagged overlay, callout, callout_text, and callout_line.
Canvas text uses screen-space coordinates and normal Tk font sizing.
Leader lines connect each label row to the projected node center.
Callouts are redrawn during projection refresh and deleted with canvas.delete('callout').

text-measurement.fit-policy: Titles are stripped, internal whitespace is collapsed, character-truncated first, then shortened further until the measured text plus ellipsis fits the pixel limit.
text-measurement.widest-title: The callout column uses the widest fitted title width, capped at CALLOUT_MAX_TEXT_PX.

placement.side-choice: If the selected cluster center is left of canvas center, labels are placed on the right; otherwise labels are placed on the left.
placement.cluster-bounds: Side choice uses selected node screen-space bounds, with rotated rectangle bounds coming from node_bounds_world(node).
placement.alignment: Right-side callouts use anchor='w' with a shared left edge. Left-side callouts use anchor='e' with a shared right edge. In both cases, the edge nearest the leader lines aligns vertically.
placement.vertical-order: Entries are sorted by projected node center y coordinate.
placement.vertical-layout: Rows use fixed spacing unless there are too many labels, in which case row spacing is compressed to fit inside the canvas margins.

dismissal: Escape or AA through cancel/selection clearing
a new marquee selection, which replaces prior callouts
non-effects: Callouts are not saved to project JSON.
Callout canvas item ids are not stored in world nodes.
Callout overlay items are not tagged as nodes and do not affect node hit-testing.
known-limitations: No wrapping; callout titles are one line.
No cap with explicit 'N more' row yet.
Pan and zoom dismiss callouts rather than keeping them live-updated as a reading aid.
Line crossings are acceptable for now.
suggested-next-work: persistent annotations as separate future world objects
